description: Disable both local bundle members; retain down member evidence without inferring absence.

apply.commands:
configure terminal
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/0/1
 shutdown
exit
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/0/3
 shutdown
exit

revert.commands:
configure terminal
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/0/1
 no shutdown
exit
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/0/3
 no shutdown
exit
